title: Apply Conservation of Momentum
text: In an isolated system, total momentum before = total momentum after: $$\Sigma p_{before} = \Sigma p_{after}$$

title: Set Up the Equation
text: After collision they stick together (perfectly inelastic collision): $$p_{before} = (m_A + m_B) \times v_{after}$$. So: $$18 = 6 \times v$$

title: Solve for Velocity
text: $$v = \frac{18}{6} = 3$$ m/s. The positive value indicates the combined trolleys move to the right.
